metadata.description: Nitin's personal Claude Code plugins: reusable skill packs for engineering, product, daily workflow, note capture, and writing.

plugins.name: eng
plugins.description: Plan-to-ship engineering pipeline. Six composable skills (scope, grill, eng-review, tdd, execute, ship) plus an orchestrator (eng-flow), each a single pass over a shared markdown doc in the project's .plan folder, with full and express tracks. Standalone skills: research, migrate, resolve-conflicts, conventions (house-style cache every other skill reads), understand, debug, spike, adr, refactor, backfill-tests, pr-walkthrough, pr-review, review.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product-thinking skills. Write staff-level PRDs, slice them into testable user stories, or run /product-flow to take an idea through both and hand off to eng's /scope. Output lands in .plan/<feature>/ where /scope reads it directly.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Daily working rhythm plus workflow helpers. /daily plans the day into a task list, /shutdown closes it with real evidence from commits and PRs, /standup prints a speakable update, /weekly reviews the week and builds your self-review evidence — all writing to one Obsidian daily note per day. Also: catchup, caveman, handoff, stress-test.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Second-brain capture for an Obsidian vault: dump what you just learned by voice or text and /note places it in the right Learn/ folder, writes it up in your own note-taking voice (not AI voice), wires up bidirectional wikilinks, and updates the index hub. Vault located via $OBSIDIAN_VAULT or by finding .obsidian/.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Plain, direct English for everything Claude writes, plus the tools to write skills. /unslop rewrites or audits text that reads like AI wrote it, /skill authors new skills to this repo's standard, and a SessionStart hook keeps the house style live in every session.
